item.title: Two Bay Area Men Among Five Sentenced to Prison For Scheme to Steal $2.5M From DoorDash
item.description: Five people, including two from the Bay Area, have been sentenced to prison terms and restitution for their parts in a strange fraud scheme involving the creation of sham driver and customer accounts on the DoorDash platform.

item.title: Jason Kelce Ran Around San Francisco Drinking Beers, and Filmed It
item.description: Another celebrity who was in town for the Super Bowl, retired Philadelphia Eagles center and soon-to-be brother-in-law of Taylor Swift Jason Kelce, did a "Beer Bucket List" video hitting multiple San Francisco landmarks.

item.title: Several Gray Whales Make 'Unseasonably Early' Appearance In the Bay
item.description: It typically would not be whale-watching season yet in San Francisco Bay, but a few gray whales, possibly due to changes in their feeding grounds up north, are making early stops in the Bay.

item.title: District Blames SF Teachers' Union For Leaving the Bargaining Table Early Tuesday Night
item.description: There is plenty of finger-pointing going on with the SF teachers' strike, but what seems clear is that the union may be sensing their upper hand at this point, and a resolution before Thursday seems unlikely.

item.title: San Jose Parents, Teachers Blindsided By Potential Closure of Nine Elementary Schools
item.description: Concerned families, teachers, and community members packed the house at the San Jose Unified School District’s community meeting Tuesday evening after receiving news last week that up to a third of its elementary schools may be shuttered due to a 20-percent reduction in enrollment.

item.title: San Leandro City Councilman Pleads Guilty, Becomes Potential Witness Against Former Oakland Mayor Sheng Thao
item.description: Former San Leandro City Councilmember Bryan Azevedo filed a guilty plea in federal court Wednesday in the corruption case that also ensnared former Oakland Mayor Sheng Thao, making him now a potential witness against her.

item.title: Video: Mount Diablo Has One of the Most Expansive Views In the West, and More Fun Facts About the Bay Area
item.description: Did you know that the Bay Area was created out of something called a drowned river valley? Do you know the history of how Treasure Island was created out of nothing in the 1930s? A fun new video explains this and more.

item.title: More SF Movie Theaters Can Sell Beer and Wine After Supervisors Relax the Rules
item.description: It’s ‘bottoms up’ at more SF movie theaters, as the Board of Supervisors just social-lubricated the red tape around alcohol sales at movie houses.

item.title: Shop in SF’s Inner Richmond Will Screenprint ‘F*ck ICE’ For Free on Items the Public Brings In
item.description: During the general strike on January 30, the folks at Fleetwood Fine Goods in the Inner Richmond began offering free “F*ck ICE” screenprints, which was met with huge success, and they’re continuing to offer the service to anyone who brings in or purchases a garment of their choice.

item.title: Day Around the Bay: Large Development By West Oakland BART Breaks Ground
item.description: SF schools will remain closed again Thursday as strike talks continue; a long-planned transit-oriented development at West Oakland BART is getting underway; and an assistant principal in San Jose was arrested in a child exploitation sting.
